open_subjects.announcer: {form} in a broadcast booth built from folded card stock, glowing warmly, paper dials and tubes
open_subjects.default: {form} glowing warmly, folded paper tubes and creased dials

motion_registers.announcer: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Paper dial needle sweeps in gentle arcs. Creases flex and breathe. Paper edges flutter softly.
motion_registers.music_open: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Paper dial needle races across the frequencies. Folds spring open crease by crease. Grille pleats ripple sharply.
motion_registers.music_close: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Paper dial settles. Folds ease flat and still. Paper glow fades to soft amber.
motion_registers.music_inter: Continuous shot, same console throughout. Paper dial steady. Pleats ripple with the rhythm. Paper strips bounce like equalizer bars.
